role: Static web portal, ecosystem registry and integration control plane
maturity: HTML/CSS/JavaScript portal and local browser simulations; not a device runtime or autonomous deployment control plane.

layers.name: Interface contracts
layers.responsibility: Versioned APIs, schemas, event formats and public data types.

layers.name: Application orchestration
layers.responsibility: Use cases, sequencing and workflow composition.

layers.name: Domain kernel
layers.responsibility: Deterministic domain models, algorithms and invariants.

layers.name: Policy and capabilities
layers.responsibility: Authorization, guardrails, bounds and allowed operations.

layers.name: Ports and contracts
layers.responsibility: Abstract clocks, storage, sources, external APIs and platform services.

layers.name: Adapters and platform
layers.responsibility: Concrete browser, OS, hardware and external-service implementations.

layers.name: State and data
layers.responsibility: Registries, persisted settings, events, artifacts and provenance.

layers.name: Runtime and delivery
layers.responsibility: Build, packaging, browser/runtime composition and deployment.

layers.name: Assurance and evidence
layers.responsibility: Tests, schemas, coverage, observability and verification records.

vertical_slices.title: Repository discovery
vertical_slices.flow: Registry input → schema validation → metadata domain → searchable catalog → detail/navigation link.

vertical_slices.title: Dependency visualization
vertical_slices.flow: Versioned provides/consumes → contract compatibility policy → graph model → portal visualization with confidence labels.

vertical_slices.title: Browser simulation
vertical_slices.flow: Synthetic input → local model → validation → visible result clearly labeled as simulation, never live hardware telemetry.

guardrails: The portal is not an autonomous GitHub controller, plugin loader, firmware runtime or hardware telemetry source. Browser labs use synthetic/local models. The canonical registry source and its mirrors must be distinguished; a visual edge is not proof of a live integration.
status_note: Architecture contract only; no capability is considered implemented without source and test evidence.
